purpose: Improve MsPacman performance and deepen scientific validation while keeping ordinary DQN and a plain report.
selection_rule: Choose each run checkpoint using development mean only, ties retain earlier. Promote the new run only if its best 20-game development mean exceeds the old model on those same 20 seeds (1542.0). Freeze this decision before inspecting the fresh 500-game final evaluation. Report all measured comparisons, including negative outcomes.
comparison_protocol: After new checkpoint selection is frozen, evaluate the old model and a random policy on the same fresh 500 final seeds for paired descriptive comparison; do not use these scores for checkpoint or hyperparameter selection.

cartpole_retraining_controls.early_stop: two consecutive development evaluations with all 20 games reaching 500
cartpole_retraining_controls.primary_model: Keep existing seed7 model; do not select among retraining controls using final scores.

scientific_validation: Known-solution two-state MDP learned by the actual DQN update across gamma/reward scales, with a no-learning control.
Frozen Q versus subsequent discounted rewards sampled within trajectories; record censoring at truncation.
limitations: The extended run changes several settings; baseline comparison does not isolate the effect of training duration.
The previous 500 final seeds have already been seen, hence a fresh final seed range.
Single-seed MsPacman training does not establish robustness across retraining.
